officialText:
(a) Two-way voice communication shall be provided between the elevator car and elevator machine room, and/or control room.

(b) If the call is not acknowledged [Subsection 2.27.1.1.3(c)] within 45 s, the call shall be automatically directed to an alternate on- or off-site location.
